issue.positionEn: A structure changes meaning when it enters another setting. Follow materials and display relationships while distinguishing design expression, brand statements and verified outcomes.
issue.introEn: A running sole becomes a fashion silhouette, fiber grows from a small weaving into a room, and archives enter public galleries. Today’s selection follows materials and the settings that give them another reading. Ongoing exhibitions keep their actual dates; two additional music signals point to forthcoming releases.
issue.closingEn: Follow the material and its sources, and leave time for outcomes that have not happened.
